title: The Bridge of Names
text: A bridge built of planks, each one carved with a name, thousands of names, worn smooth by passing feet. Some of the names are your ancestors'. The bridge holds only those who give one of their own to it, and the gaps between the planks are very dark.

options.label: Each Scion decides: carve their own name into a plank.

outcomes.text: Their name joins the others, and something of them stays behind with it.

options.label: Each Scion decides: cross on a dead stranger's name.

outcomes.text: Nobody notices the lie. The dead name holds.
The plank under them notices, and gives way.
